# API — Routing

The `routing` package hosts affinity metrics and the warm-starting
helper used by `TSNAffinityStrategy`.

## Modules

- `tsn_affinity.routing.metrics` — `compute_action_affinity`,
  `compute_action_affinity_batch`, `compute_latent_affinity`,
  `compute_latent_affinity_batch`, `compute_hybrid_affinity`,
  `compute_diag_stats`, `extract_obs_latents`, `normalize_scores`,
  `AffinityMetric`.
- `tsn_affinity.routing.warmstarter` — `MaskWarmstarter`.
